## Selected Projects

### Evaluating the Confidence-Interval Performance of the Double LASSO Estimator
- Focus: finite-sample inference for Double LASSO in high-dimensional linear models.
- Method: Monte Carlo simulations across Gaussian, heavy-tailed, and approximate-sparse DGPs; evaluates coverage, interval length, bias, and RMSE.
- Key finding: plug-in penalties deliver near-nominal coverage; heavy tails widen intervals; OLS becomes unstable as dimensionality approaches sample size.
- Tools: Python, Quarto.
- GitHub: https://github.com/mrshohruh/Double_Lasso

### Uzbekistan Housing Market Research Agent
- Focus: autonomous research agent that turns raw housing data into a full market and policy report.
- Method: ingests JSON, SQL, CSV, Excel, or live database inputs; infers column semantics in English, Russian, and Uzbek; computes cross-sectional and time-series statistics (growth, seasonality, structural breaks, regional convergence); identifies drivers via correlation and multivariate OLS; and researches the policy and macroeconomic backdrop on the web.
- Key finding: produces a 13-section Word report with charts, tables, a dated policy timeline, and evidence-backed recommendations, running fully offline or with Claude for narrative synthesis.
- Tools: Python, pandas, Streamlit, Anthropic Claude API.
- GitHub: https://github.com/mrshohruh/Economic-Research-Agent
